records.text: A Daily Wire producer contacted Maggie Wegner about auditioning for a solo show two days after Ben Shapiro's AmericaFest speech.
records.speaker: Maggie Wegner

appearances.snippet: It reads, Dear Candace, I believe it was two days after Ben Shapiro's speech at AmFest, a producer from The Daily Wire who has been nothing but kind to me, reached out.

verification.notes: Candace reads a message attributed to Maggie Wegner, but the private outreach, timing, and sender identity cannot be independently authenticated.

records.text: The proposed show was presented as comedy about both political sides, but the producer immediately identified Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson as targets.
records.speaker: Maggie Wegner

appearances.snippet: It was presented to me as a comedy show to make fun of the right and the left. ... However, immediately, you and Tucker Carlson were brought up.

verification.notes: The account comes from a private message and internal pitch; no independent public record establishes the full framing or targets of the proposed show.

records.text: The audition script and AI sample focused entirely on mocking Candace Owens.
records.speaker: Maggie Wegner

appearances.snippet: I was baffled. The entire show audition was making fun of you.

verification.notes: The episode describes and plays purported audition material, but the full materials and their provenance are not independently available for authentication.

records.text: Maggie Wegner declined to submit the audition because it felt untrue and like high-school bullying.
records.speaker: Maggie Wegner

appearances.snippet: I told blank that I was not comfortable sending in a video as it did not feel true to me. ... I even tried to rewrite it in a way that was true to me, but I couldn't do it. It just felt like high school bullies.

verification.notes: This is Maggie Wegner's reported account of her own private decision, conveyed through an email read on the show; no independent evidence confirms it.

records.text: Maggie Wegner did not receive the Daily Wire role after declining to make the audition.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
